items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet suffered a non-contact knee injury late in TNF win over Patriots, carted off; coach Ben Johnson said it 'didn't look very good' and more tests today. Appears lost for now, already ruled out of remaining game action.
items.why: Non-contact knee buckle, carted, coach comments negative, tests pending but looks significant.
items.implication: Colston Loveland sole TE1 with expanded snaps/routes; Luther Burden may see more 11-personnel and route juice as 2/3-TE sets drop.
items.opportunity: Loveland route/target share spike; Burden YPRR already elite at reduced rate.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday with a calf injury and is listed as limited. Believed to be minor per later reports.
items.why: Exited practice with calf; reports call it minor.
items.implication: Monitor Friday/Saturday reports; expected to play but snap/target risk if worsens. Already high-volume post-Adams.
items.opportunity: If limited or out, TE targets (Higbee) or remaining WRs rise further.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson has played on just 21% of the snaps over the last three weeks. Not like this.
items.why: Persistently low snap share recent weeks indicates limited role.
items.implication: Sit or drop in shallow leagues; handcuff/backup value only unless role expands.
items.opportunity: Low; monitor for any injury to primary back.

items.text: Luther Burden has run only 68.8% of routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR. Cole Kmet injury likely reduces 2- and 3-TE sets, giving Burden even more juice.
items.why: Elite efficiency on limited routes; personnel shift from Kmet absence expands opportunity.
items.implication: Burden WR2/3 upside rises ROS and this week; start with more confidence in PPR.
items.opportunity: Higher route rate and targets in 11 personnel.

items.text: Colts will have a decision to make on RB Jonathan Taylor (amid multi-team trade interest context from prior).
items.implication: Potential trade or role clarity; handcuff value elevated.
items.opportunity: If moved or limited, backups rise.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical treatments and non-football activities at facility. Backups MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) have been quite bad amid OL issues.
items.why: Facility access positive for return timeline; backups inefficient.
items.implication: Jacobs still viable RB1/2 ROS once cleared; don't overvalue Lloyd/Johnson.
items.opportunity: Jacobs workload upon return; backups poor EPA limits their standalone.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is 'in line' to play vs Dallas MNF (RB15 rank). Efficient in full games played; Dallas strong fantasy RB matchup.
items.why: Practice return and efficiency notes; matchup boost.
items.implication: Start as RB1/2 if active; monitor final designation.
items.opportunity: Featured back volume vs soft Dallas run D.

items.text: Lamar Jackson got in limited work Wednesday (despite no early practice sighting); continued limited Thursday with growing return optimism for Week 7.
items.why: HC confirmed limited work; progression noted.
items.implication: QB1 upside if plays; monitor final status vs ankle.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson not expected ready off IR soon (recovery takes time). Notable as biggest Adams beneficiary delayed; Rams' only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson delay + Adams long-term hamstring leaves Puka as primary target hog.
items.implication: Puka elite WR1 volume locked in; calf monitor but ceiling massive.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10). Back in real role with usage and Bears defense good for yardage.
items.why: Elite volume/role return + favorable matchup vs Bears.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; buy if available.
items.opportunity: High target share and routes confirmed in prior game.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (elite volume), Tucker Kraft @ DET (Lions gift to pass catchers), Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR (workloads + friendly matchups).
items.why: Usage + matchup juice (Lions pass D soft, RB-friendly spots).
items.implication: Start with confidence; Kraft TE upside, RBs RB1/2 range.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low-scoring issues), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D), Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload post-layoff), Cam Skattebo @ HOU (brutal spot).
items.why: Nasty matchups, role concerns, or inefficiency risks.
items.implication: Sit or fade; Jacobs short-term caution despite longer outlook.
items.opportunity: Limited or pressured in these spots.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive on Jacobs facility/backups.

items.text: Stroud top-6 QB last 3 wks, 4th YPG, top-10 attempts (Texans run weak). Nix aDOT only 5.4, almost no deep completions recently (no WR viable). Jeanty inefficient <3 YPC often, Washington rising snaps/touches.
items.implication: Stroud QB1 upside; fade Nix/WRs; monitor Jeanty role split.
items.opportunity: Stroud pass volume; Jeanty snap decline risk.

items.text: AJ Brown 33% target share, 97% routes despite drops/poor YAC (buy). Michael Mayer >70% routes and 18% targets/15 PPG in 3/4 games since Bowers return (streamable); Raiders WR target share last.
items.why: High utilization scores and target shares.
items.implication: Buy Brown; Mayer viable even with Bowers active.
items.opportunity: Brown route/target dominance; Mayer consistent TE2/stream.
